name: Convex-Geometry Ideals Are Strictly Cover-Recursive
scope: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
statement: Every finite convex-geometry ideal admits a cover-recursive peripheral construction, and the containment is strict.
proof: The median-ideal construction supplies the recursive peripheral certificate. The verified nonrealizable peripheral class $E_{26}$ lies in the larger class but is not a convex-geometry ideal.
